items.label: Check identity document validity and record its expiry for your own reference
Collect copies of your genuine qualification and training evidence
Prepare truthful employment history, references and project evidence
Verify the employer website and application destination independently
Review written salary, work location, hours and employer responsibilities
Estimate relocation costs, living expenses and emergency savings
Look up the correct work/visa/permit route using the official links for your situation
Ask the relevant authority whether credential recognition or language proof applies
Verify whether translations or authentication are needed for your specific case
Check insurance or other entry requirements on the official authority website

disclaimer: This is a generic personal planning checklist, NOT a list of mandatory visa documents or an eligibility decision. Requirements vary by nationality, work type and permit route; check the linked authorities for current rules. Do not upload passports or personal documents.
